core_obligations: Use local projectivity on the etale site to present the module as a direct summand of a product of copies of the structure sheaf.
Apply the resulting exact sequence of internal hom sheaves to conclude the vanishing of the first cohomology.

proof_roadmap.step: Translate local projectivity on the etale site into a direct summand statement.
Write the internal hom sheaf in terms of the resulting presentation.
Conclude vanishing of the first cohomology.

difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for quasi-coherent modules on the small etale site of an affine scheme, with the first module locally projective, the first cohomology of the internal hom sheaf vanishes. The proof uses the definition of local projectivity on the etale site, reduces the internal hom to a direct summand of a product of copies of the structure sheaf, and then applies the exactness of the relevant sequence to conclude vanishing. The reduction of local projectivity to a statement about direct summands on the etale site is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 4802-4812 with the surrounding argument.

dedup.scope: Cross-chapter same-name pair decided by the statements alone: both sides conclude the vanishing of the first cohomology of the internal hom sheaf for a locally projective first module on an affine. This side states it for quasi-coherent modules on the small etale site, the wider setting, and carries the genuine 19-line proof, so it is the side counted. Compared against all focused-seeds task.json, PREPARATION_WORKLIST.jsonl, and public intervals for spaces-more-morphisms.tex.

compared.difference: Hypothesis difference: the schemes side works with quasi-coherent modules on the Zariski topology of an affine scheme; this side works on the small etale site. Conclusion difference: none, both conclude the vanishing of the first cohomology of the internal hom sheaf.
